class: An AI's 'for you' on a box the page itself calls optional stopped a finished application
symptom: Meta, 30 September: every question answered (gender Male, race, veteran, locations), then NEEDS YOU -- 'needs your answer: Password (Rule 5 states never touch password boxes.)' for the optional Career Profile account's password.
site: Meta careers; any application with an optional account section
root_cause: blockers() turned every required 'for you' item of the AI's plan into a reason to stop; the AI marked the optional account's Password required, and nothing checked it against the page's own '(optional)' heading.
why_tests_missed: No page in the tests had an optional account under the application.
fix: On a page whose account section says it is optional (account_state._OPTIONAL_ACCOUNT), its password / one-time-code boxes are never 'for you': they stay empty and do not stop the hand-over.
prevention: What the page says about a section outranks the AI's guess about it; an AI 'required' is checked against the page before it stops a run.
